Messages.Author: Malachy
Messages.Body:
Heys!

Here's the theory: Via  Agent of Power my gangrel gets an inferior level of Spiritus... That's a trifle, so thereafter comes a  Feral Spirit . She becomes Ahrimane and gets superior Spiritus. Is sup SPI maintained after the Agent is burned? I think Feral Spirit should provide the given level permanently dispite the fact that an inferior level "has been burned" since because the wording -as far as I can tell- refers to present circumstances. Once gained cannot be "gained again differently later due to this or that".

NC of Hungary

///

The card text provided by the Secret Library is not necessarily up to date. Please include the card text in your message, rather than a link.

Name: Feral Spirit
Cardtype: Master
Master.
Put this card on a Gangrel or Gangrel antitribu you control. This vampire is now Ahrimane (and Sabbat). This vampire gains one level of Spiritus [spi]. This vampire is now sterile.

Feral Spirit provides 1 level of Spiritus, not superior Spiritus. While the Agent of Power is on him, he has 2 levels of Spiritus (meaning superior Spiritus).
When the Agent of Power burns, the vampire is left with 1 level of Spiritus, meaning inferior Spiritus.

Prince of Paris, France

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Ankha's response is correct:  [LSJ 20011227] (parallel between Vial of Garou Blood and Agent of Power - when the effect ends, the level of discipline isn't granted anymore; and, as Ankha said, Feral Spirit doesn't give superior, but just 1 level).
